description:
Financial statements time series for one or more tickers,
    chart-ready. Each period is a flat ~27-field object spanning the
    income statement (revenue, gross / operating / EBITDA / net margins,
    EPS, R&D), the balance sheet (total assets, total debt, total
    equity, net debt, cash + short-term investments), the cash flow
    statement (operating cash flow, free cash flow, capex, dividends
    paid, buybacks), and four ratios (current ratio, debt-to-equity,
    return on equity, return on assets).

    Margins and returns are emitted as percentages — gross_margin_pct
    of 49.27 means 49.27%. Cash outflows (dividends_paid, buybacks) are
    returned as negative numbers, matching the source convention.

    Use for: "AAPL revenue and FCF over the last 10 years", "show
    margins trend", "is net debt rising", "EPS growth", and comparisons
    across companies: "debt-to-equity for these 13 stocks", "compare
    the big Canadian banks' financials".

    To compare several companies, pass them all in `tickers` in one
    call: the result has one {ticker, currency, periods} block per
    company. Every company asked for comes back or is named in
    `not_included`: when the result would be too large, each company
    first gets fewer of the most recent periods (a `note` says so), and
    only when one period each does not fit are the last companies left
    out.

count.description: Number of most-recent periods per company (default 5, max 40), ordered oldest-first inside each `periods` array.
count.title: Count

ticker.description: One stock ticker (e.g. 'AAPL', 'NVDA'). For several, use `tickers`.
ticker.title: Ticker

tickers.description: Several comma-separated tickers to compare in one call (e.g. 'TD,RY,BMO'), up to 20.
tickers.title: Tickers
